channel.title: 7News · AI creation
channel.description: AI creation channel: original summaries from official sources

item.title: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 on SageMaker JumpStart for private realtime dialog
item.description: Dialog-RSN-1 on Marketplace and JumpStart: deploy a realtime voice endpoint in your VPC; OpenAI Realtime compatible; 16-bit PCM mono 16/24 kHz; ~30-minute connections; English only for now.

item.title: Genie 4 is live for Ultra: real-time world edits, audio, and a gallery
item.description: Google DeepMind updates Project Genie with Genie 4 for eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers—natural-language live edits, adaptive audio, a creative agent, and a community gallery; Pro users can join the waitlist.

item.title: Microsoft MAI-Image-2.7 and Flash hit Vercel AI Gateway preview
item.description: Vercel Changelog: microsoft/mai-image-2.7 and mai-image-2.7-flash in public preview on AI Gateway—up to 2048×2048, transparent backgrounds, up to five reference images; no Microsoft account required.

item.title: Nanjing Museum × SenseTime — VR walk-in Kunyu Wanguo Quantu
item.description: SenseTime news: Nanjing Museum–led, SenseTime-built AI+VR immersion of the Kunyu world map at China’s museum expo; full experience cited at 280k+ visits since Jul 2025.

item.title: ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Flash lands on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel Changelog: bytedance/seedance-2.5-flash—faster, cheaper Seedance 2.5; text or image/video/audio refs to synced A/V clips, 4–30s up to 720p@24fps; AI SDK 7.

item.title: SenseTime Seko backs Golden Rooster–honored AI short Invincible Superman
item.description: SenseTime says its Seko AI video platform supplied tools and compute for Invincible Superman, which won the 39th Golden Rooster Future Imaging AI Unit’s annual technology application award.

item.title: MiniMax H3 Image and Highspeed land on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel Changelog: minimax/minimax-h3-image and the highspeed variant support text-to-image and edits via AI Gateway—custom sizes through 2K/4K, no separate MiniMax account.

item.title: ByteDance Seedream 5.5: 100-round edits and native RGBA
item.description: Seed ships Seedream 5.5 with pixel-stable multi-round editing (up to ~100 rounds), native RGBA transparency, and sharper text/texture—rolling out on Jimeng, Doubao, and Volcano Ark.

item.title: SenseTime Raccoon cases show SenseNova U1 Pro multi-turn image workflows
item.description: A SenseTime news feature uses two user stories to show how Raccoon, backed by SenseNova U1 Pro, handles layered Chinese-style art prompts and business diagrams with multi-turn edits.
